sentences.text: Whiplash is a 2014 American drama film written and directed by Damien Chazelle , depicting the relationship between an ambitious jazz student -LRB- Miles Teller -RRB- and an aggressive instructor -LRB- J. K. Simmons -RRB- .	Damien Chazelle	Damien Chazelle	Miles Teller	Miles Teller	J. K. Simmons	J. K. Simmons	drama film	Drama (modern genre)	jazz	jazz
Paul Reiser co-stars as the student 's father .	Paul Reiser	Paul Reiser
The film opened in limited release domestically in the US and Canada on October 10 , 2014 , gradually expanding to over 500 screens and finally closing after 24 weeks on March 26 , 2015 .
Over this time the film grossed $ 49 million , against a production budget of $ 3.3 million .

Whiplash premiered in competition in the US Dramatic Category at the 2014 Sundance Film Festival on January 16 , 2014 , as the festival 's opening film .	Sundance	2014 Sundance Film Festival	2014 Sundance Film Festival	2014 Sundance Film Festival
Sony Pictures Worldwide acquired the international distribution rights .	Sony Pictures Worldwide	Sony Pictures Worldwide Acquisitions
